candidate_sentence_map.S1: Hepsor AS reported consolidated revenue of 35.4 million euros for the full year 2025, representing a decline from 38.4 million euros in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: The Group recorded a net profit of 1.0 million euros for the year, a significant decrease from the 2.1 million euros reported in 2024.

candidate_sentence_map.S8: The gross profit margin declined to 15.9% in 2025 from 17.6% in 2024.

candidate_sentence_map.S12: Despite lower annual revenue, the Group’s development pipeline expanded significantly.

candidate_sentence_map.S15: This growth in pre-sales was supported by stabilized interest rates and positive economic outlooks in Estonia and Latvia.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: The Group also strengthened its balance sheet, with total equity increasing by 23.0% to 27.1 million euros.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: The debt ratio improved to 52.0% from 61.6% in the previous year, aided by the successful issuance of 8.0 million euros in bonds in November 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Total assets grew by 3.4% to 91.8 million euros, while total liabilities decreased by 24.2% to 50.6 million euros.

The Group posted a net loss of 0.5 million euros in Q4 2025, reversing the 1.0 million euro net profit recorded in Q4 2024.
